summary: Blast radius: NDJSON files with # comment lines (valid in 0.34) are now INPUT_INVALID NOT_JSON; the CHANGELOG lists it as breaking with the fix, and canon/skills/SKILL.src.md was updated. Anything outside the repo that writes NDJSON with comment lines (scripts, agent prompts, example files not under tests) is not exercised by the checks; I found none in the repo that the suite does not already run (input.rs every_spec_example_document passes). Also not in scope but seen: the batch pointers read /items/N/... where spec 11.8/11.11 say /N/...; that is canon-0-35-batch-pointers.
